latency_scope: End-to-end offline pipeline: decode, inference, tracking, counting, drawing and JPEG; excludes database and viewer transport. FPS includes cold first inference. Detector inference uses Ultralytics speed telemetry.
reference_semantics: Human trajectory boxes; normalized center; boundary outside; confirmation=3; startup inside is occupancy only; lost grace=2 seconds without synthetic exit.
coordinate_conversion: Subtract one from left and top before clipping/normalization; width/height remain unchanged; frame indices stay 1-based.
gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU
scope: Selected public training sequences; derived area-counting scores, not official MOT benchmark scores

alignment.validation: exact metadata/frame-count check; preview reencoding cannot prove pixel identity
